note: Parody champions: made-up names that nod to famous grapplers. Original art (no real faces). Every champion is a mind-controlled victim who gets freed and thanks the crew.

bosses.name: GORDO RYEMAN, THE PRESSURE KING
bosses.name_pt: GORDO RYEMAN, O REI DA PRESSÃO
bosses.intro: You came to MY gym? Hope you like carrying weight!
bosses.intro_pt: Vieram na MINHA academia? Espero que gostem de carregar peso!
bosses.defeat: Ugh, my head... Did I just pull guard? Thanks, crew. Go!
bosses.defeat_pt: Ai, minha cabeça... Eu puxei pra guarda? Valeu, galera. Vão!

bosses.name: CRAIG BONES, THE LEGLOCK TRICKSTER
bosses.name_pt: CRAIG BONES, O TRAPACEIRO DAS CHAVES
bosses.intro: G'day! Fancy a leglock? Don't worry mate, I'll go easy... not!
bosses.intro_pt: E aí, parceiro! Bora uma chave de pé? Relaxa, vou pegar leve... só que não!
bosses.defeat: Fair dinkum, you got me! Tell the masked bloke I quit.
bosses.defeat_pt: Justo, vocês me pegaram! Diz pro mascarado que eu desisti.
bosses.art: a lanky goofy Australian beach grappler with a floppy bucket hat, white zinc sunscreen stripe on his nose, a sky-blue rash guard and board shorts, one leg twisted around in a tricky leg-entanglement spin, sly grin

bosses.name: FYODOR EMELIANVIL, THE IRON SAMBIST
bosses.name_pt: FYODOR EMELIANVIL, O SAMBISTA DE FERRO
bosses.intro: Hm. You will need more than smiles.
bosses.intro_pt: Hm. Vocês vão precisar de mais que sorrisos.
bosses.defeat: Good. You fight with heart. Thank you.
bosses.defeat_pt: Bom. Vocês lutam com o coração. Obrigado.
bosses.art: a calm stoic powerful sambo champion with a quiet expression and short dark hair, wearing a steel-gray sambo jacket with riveted iron shoulder plates, red sambo shorts and shoes, fists ready, unshakable

bosses.name: JORDAN BURROWSTONE, THE OLYMPIC WRESTLER
bosses.intro: Hands on the mat! I've got a double leg with your name on it!
bosses.intro_pt: Mãos no tatame! Tenho uma baiana com o nome de vocês!
bosses.defeat: Great shot! Whoa, I feel like myself again. Go get 'em!
bosses.defeat_pt: Bela entrada! Uau, voltei a ser eu mesmo. Vão pegar eles!
bosses.art: an explosive muscular freestyle wrestler in a red singlet with a gold star, several gold medals around his neck, wrestling headgear pushed up, low double-leg shooting stance, fast blur lines

bosses.name: MARCELO GRACIAS, THE BUTTERFLY MASTER
bosses.intro: Hello my friends! Come, sit in my guard. It's very comfortable.
bosses.intro_pt: Olá, meus amigos! Venham, sentem na minha guarda. É muito confortável.
bosses.defeat: Ahh, thank you! Now we train together, yes? Very good!
bosses.defeat_pt: Ahh, obrigado! Agora a gente treina junto, né? Muito bom!
bosses.art: a small friendly humble grappler with a huge warm smile in a royal-blue gi and black belt, seated butterfly-guard pose with hooks up, glowing violet magic butterfly wings behind him

bosses.name: ROGER GRACIOUS, THE GI GRANDMASTER
bosses.name_pt: ROGER GRACIOUS, O GRÃO-MESTRE DO KIMONO
bosses.intro: Everyone knows what I will do. Nobody can stop it.
bosses.intro_pt: Todo mundo sabe o que eu vou fazer. Ninguém consegue impedir.
bosses.defeat: Simple is beautiful. You did the basics well. Obrigado.
bosses.defeat_pt: O simples é bonito. Vocês fizeram o básico bem. Obrigado.
bosses.art: a tall calm composed gi grandmaster in a spotless white gi and black belt with red bar, short dark hair, one hand reaching for a cross-collar grip, serene confident half-smile

bosses.name: MIKEY MOZZARELLA, DARTH LINGUINE
bosses.intro: Welcome to my kitchen! Today's special: inverted guard al dente!
bosses.intro_pt: Bem-vindos à minha cozinha! O prato do dia: guarda invertida al dente!
bosses.defeat: Mamma mia, the spell's gone! Who wants pasta?
bosses.defeat_pt: Mamma mia, o feitiço sumiu! Quem quer macarrão?
bosses.art: a small super-flexible young prodigy in a black gi with a dark sci-fi visor mask pushed up, a red cape that looks like a pasta-sauce-stained napkin, holding a fork wrapped in linguine like a laser sword, spinning upside-down inverted pose

bosses.name: PROFESSOR DANA-HAIR, THE RASH GUARD PROFESSOR
bosses.name_pt: PROFESSOR DANA-HAIR, O PROFESSOR DE RASH GUARD
bosses.intro: Let us consider, carefully, the seventeen ways I will defeat you.
bosses.intro_pt: Consideremos, com cuidado, as dezessete formas como vou derrotar vocês.
bosses.defeat: Fascinating. A variable I did not account for: friendship.
bosses.defeat_pt: Fascinante. Uma variável que eu não previ: a amizade.
bosses.art: a lean intense professorial grappling coach in a navy-blue rash guard and black spats, round glasses, holding a whiteboard marker and a small whiteboard covered in arrows and diagrams, raised lecturing finger

bosses.name: EDDIE BRAVE, THE RUBBER GUARD REBEL
bosses.name_pt: EDDIE BRAVE, O REBELDE DA GUARDA DE BORRACHA
bosses.short_pt: O REBELDE DA GUARDA DE BORRACHA
bosses.intro: Wake up, man! Nothing is what it seems... except my rubber guard!
bosses.intro_pt: Acorda, cara! Nada é o que parece... menos a minha guarda de borracha!
bosses.defeat: Whoa. Was I under a spell? Or was it all a simulation?
bosses.defeat_pt: Uau. Eu tava enfeitiçado? Ou era tudo uma simulação?
bosses.art: a laid-back rebel grappler in a psychedelic tie-dye rash guard and black no-gi shorts, a bandana headband, an electric guitar slung on his back, one leg pulled high in a bendy rubber-guard pose, cosmic swirl sparkles

bosses.name: THE MASKED CHAMPION
bosses.intro: So, the garage gym made it. Your fun ends here.
bosses.intro_pt: Então a academia de garagem chegou. A diversão de vocês acaba aqui.
bosses.defeat: Why are you smiling? ...I forgot. I used to love this too.
bosses.defeat_pt: Por que vocês estão sorrindo? ...Eu esqueci. Eu também amava isso.
bosses.art: the final villain: a tall imposing grappler in a long dark hooded robe over a black gi, smooth gold mask with no face, holding a glowing violet cursed technique scroll, swirling purple spell runes and mist around him

skel: Stays back and throws balls of finger tape.
a hypnotized purple-belt grappler in a white gi throwing balls of white athletic finger tape, arm cocked back to throw
spider: Scrappy little grinder who rushes the line.
a tiny scrappy hypnotized kid grappler in a yellow rash guard and gi pants, crouched low and scurrying forward on all fours
brute: Big, tough and hard to move.
a huge hypnotized brown-belt grappler in a worn gi with a brown belt, thick arms, cracking knuckles
ghost: Drifts through walls like it isn't there.
a translucent ghostly violet spirit of a grappler in a gi, floating, wispy legs fading into mist
golem: Slow, massive and hits like a truck.
a gigantic slow hypnotized super-heavyweight grappler in a black singlet, belly and huge shoulders, lumbering
wizard: Shouts spell bolts from the corner. Take him out first.
a hypnotized coach in a dark tracksuit holding a glowing violet clipboard and shouting, purple magic bolts from his mouth
bomber: Sprints in wired on energy and pops on contact.
a jittery hyperactive teen grappler chugging a glowing purple energy drink can, crackling with electric energy, sprinting
charger: Winds up, then shoots a double leg straight at you.
a stocky hypnotized wrestler in an orange singlet lowering his head to shoot a double-leg takedown like a charging bull, steam from nose
shaman: Heals and pumps up nearby rivals.
a hypnotized cornerman in a hoodie with a towel, spray bottle and ice pack, glowing green healing sparkles
necro: Stays back and calls in white belts. Take him out first.
a pompous hypnotized fake-martial-arts sensei in a shiny gold gi with a ridiculously long rainbow belt covered in stripes, arms raised summoning students
splitter: Split into two white belts when beaten.
two identical hypnotized twin grapplers in matching teal gis standing back to back, glowing violet eyes
voidling: Blinks next to your line without warning.
a small floating violet magic wisp creature shaped like a tiny hooded grappler, glowing eyes, sparkles
inkwraith: A shadow that blinks around the room.
a dark navy ink-like shadow phantom shaped like a grappler, dripping ink wisps, glowing violet eyes
shardgolem: A giant living trophy. Shatters into Blue Belts!
a giant walking golden tournament trophy golem with arms and legs, cracked and glowing violet
cogknight: Turtles up behind a shield. Hit him when it drops!
a hypnotized grappler curled in a defensive turtle position wearing a big shell-like back pad as a shield, peeking out
abyssfiend: Charges your line and bursts into flames when beaten.
a fiery red berserker grappler with flaming hair, torn red rash guard, roaring, charging
shade: Fades into shadow. Hit it when it shows itself!
a sneaky hypnotized grappler dressed in a black ninja-style gi and mask, half fading into shadow
doomcaller: Calls in students and heals every rival nearby.
an absurdly grand fake grandmaster in a flowing purple robe and a belt with fifty rainbow stripes, golden whistle, glowing staff

frames.t: The Pressure King blinked. The purple glow left his eyes. 'Whoa... did I just crush a whole tournament? Sorry, guys.'
frames.pt: O Rei da Pressão piscou. O brilho roxo sumiu dos olhos dele. 'Uau... eu esmaguei um campeonato inteiro? Foi mal, galera.'
frames.p: a huge heavyweight grappler in a black gi with a small gold crown sitting dazed on garage gym puzzle mats, purple glow fading from his eyes, a small friendly crew helping him up, warm light

frames.t: 'A masked guy handed me a scroll after my last match,' he said. 'Next thing I knew, I was taking orders.'
frames.pt: 'Um cara mascarado me entregou um pergaminho depois da minha última luta', ele disse. 'Quando vi, eu estava obedecendo ordens.'
frames.p: flashback scene: a masked figure in a dark hood handing a glowing violet scroll to a tired champion after a match in an arena tunnel, ominous purple light

frames.t: He pointed at a map. 'He sent my buddy Craig to a beach gym down south. Bring sunscreen. And watch your legs.'
frames.pt: Ele apontou para um mapa. 'Ele mandou meu parceiro Craig para uma academia de praia lá no sul. Levem protetor solar. E cuidado com as pernas.'
frames.p: a crumpled paper map pinned to a garage gym wall with a red marker circle around a sunny beach, a crew of cartoon grapplers leaning in excited

story.title: Leglocks and Sunscreen
story.title_pt: Chaves de Pé e Protetor Solar

frames.t: Craig Bones untangled himself and laughed. 'Mate, that was the best roll I've had all year! Even if I was hypnotized.'
frames.pt: Craig Bones se desenrolou e riu. 'Parceiro, foi o melhor treino do ano! Mesmo eu estando hipnotizado.'
frames.p: a lanky goofy beach grappler in a bucket hat and sunscreen laughing on teal mats in a beach shack gym at sunset, a crew of cartoon grapplers laughing with him

frames.t: 'The masked bloke collects champions like trophies. He took the Iron Sambist next. Quiet fella. Hits like a train.'
frames.pt: 'O mascarado coleciona campeões como troféus. Depois ele levou o Sambista de Ferro. Um cara quieto. Bate igual a um trem.'
frames.p: a shadowy trophy shelf with small glowing figurines of champions on it, a masked figure's gold-gloved hand placing a new figurine, purple light

frames.t: So the crew packed their gear, waved goodbye to the beach, and headed for the cold, quiet Iron Sambo Hall.
frames.pt: Então a equipe arrumou as mochilas, deu tchau para a praia e partiu para o frio e silencioso Salão de Ferro do Sambo.
frames.p: a crew of cute cartoon grapplers with gym bags walking toward a big snowy old iron-gated sports hall at dusk, snowflakes

frames.t: The Iron Sambist stood very still. Then he smiled, just a little. 'Thank you. The spell was heavy. Heavier than me.'
frames.pt: O Sambista de Ferro ficou parado. Então sorriu, só um pouquinho. 'Obrigado. O feitiço era pesado. Mais pesado que eu.'
frames.p: a calm stoic sambo champion in a steel-gray jacket with iron shoulder plates giving a tiny smile in a dim crimson sambo hall, purple mist fading away

frames.t: 'The masked one fears joy,' he said. 'Every champion he takes forgets why they started. You must remind them.'
frames.pt: 'O mascarado tem medo da alegria', ele disse. 'Todo campeão que ele leva esquece por que começou. Vocês precisam lembrá-los.'
frames.p: a wise quiet champion and a small crew sitting around a warm stove in an old sports hall, sharing tea, cozy and serious

frames.t: Next stop: a college wrestling room, where a gold-medal wrestler was shooting doubles on anyone who walked in.
frames.pt: Próxima parada: uma sala de luta de faculdade, onde um campeão olímpico derrubava qualquer um que entrasse.
frames.p: exterior of a college gym building at night with a glowing window, silhouettes inside of a wrestler shooting takedowns, purple glow

frames.t: Jordan Burrowstone popped up off the mat, medals jingling. 'Okay, okay, you got me! Best scramble I've seen in years!'
frames.pt: Jordan Burrowstone pulou do tatame, com as medalhas tilintando. 'Tá bom, tá bom, vocês me pegaram! Melhor scramble que eu vi em anos!'
frames.p: an athletic wrestler in a red singlet with gold medals jumping up happily on a maroon wrestling mat, high-fiving a cartoon wrestler in a blue singlet

frames.t: He showed them a flyer he'd found in his bag: 'World Grand Prix. Invitation only. The champions will be... collected.'
frames.pt: Ele mostrou um panfleto que achou na mochila: 'Grand Prix Mundial. Somente convidados. Os campeões serão... colecionados.'
frames.p: close-up of a black and gold invitation card with a golden mask emblem glowing violet, held by a grappler's hands, dramatic

frames.t: But first, a stop in New York, where the Butterfly Master was sweeping everyone into a trance.
frames.pt: Mas antes, uma parada em Nova York, onde o Mestre Borboleta estava raspando todo mundo para dentro de um transe.
frames.p: a New York city street at dusk with a small basement grappling academy sign with a butterfly logo, violet butterflies glowing out of the windows

frames.t: Marcelo Gracias sat up, beaming. 'My friends! You have very good hooks. Come, let me show you something.'
frames.pt: Marcelo Gracias se sentou, radiante. 'Meus amigos! Vocês têm ganchos muito bons. Venham, deixa eu mostrar uma coisa.'
frames.p: a small friendly grappler with a huge smile in a blue gi sitting in butterfly guard teaching a crew of cartoon grapplers on blue tatami, violet butterflies turning into normal yellow butterflies

frames.t: He taught the crew his favorite sweep, and for one hour everyone forgot about masks and spells and just trained.
frames.pt: Ele ensinou à equipe sua raspagem favorita, e por uma hora todo mundo esqueceu de máscaras e feitiços e só treinou.
frames.p: a joyful crowded grappling class with everyone drilling sweeps, laughter, sweat, sunlight through high basement windows

frames.t: 'Go to Rio,' he said. 'The Gi Grandmaster is there. He is very... simple. Very strong. Be careful of his collar grip.'
frames.pt: 'Vão para o Rio', ele disse. 'O Grão-Mestre do Kimono está lá. Ele é muito... simples. Muito forte. Cuidado com a pegada na gola.'
frames.p: a view of Rio de Janeiro with Sugarloaf mountain at sunset and a small green and yellow academy building on a hillside, faint violet aura over it

frames.t: Roger Gracious bowed to the crew. 'You beat me with the basics. That is the highest compliment.'
frames.pt: Roger Gracious fez uma reverência para a equipe. 'Vocês me venceram com o básico. Esse é o maior elogio.'
frames.p: a tall calm gi grandmaster in a white gi bowing respectfully to a small cartoon crew on green and yellow tatami, warm Rio sunset light

frames.t: 'The scroll is a copy of a forbidden technique,' he said. 'Win with it once, and you never want to lose again. That is the trap.'
frames.pt: 'O pergaminho é a cópia de uma técnica proibida', ele disse. 'Vence com ele uma vez, e você nunca mais quer perder. Essa é a armadilha.'
frames.p: an ancient glowing violet scroll unrolled on a wooden table, showing mysterious technique diagrams and spiral runes, candlelight, mysterious

frames.t: The trail led to a tiny mat room above a pasta shop, where the Darth of the Berimbolo was spinning in circles.
frames.pt: A trilha levou a um pequeno tatame em cima de uma cantina, onde o Darth do Berimbolo girava sem parar.
frames.p: a cozy Italian pasta restaurant street at night with a glowing upstairs window, a tiny upside-down spinning silhouette inside, violet sparkles

frames.t: Mikey Mozzarella landed upside down and grinned. 'You know what this calls for? Pasta. Lots of it.'
frames.pt: Mikey Mozzarella caiu de cabeça pra baixo e sorriu. 'Sabe o que isso pede? Macarrão. Muito macarrão.'
frames.p: a small flexible prodigy in a black gi with a visor pushed up, upside down on red and white checkered mats, grinning, holding a fork of linguine, the crew laughing

frames.t: Over the biggest plate of linguine anyone had ever seen, the champions they'd freed started to trade stories.
frames.pt: Diante do maior prato de linguine que alguém já viu, os campeões libertados começaram a trocar histórias.
frames.p: a huge joyful dinner table in an Italian restaurant with a crew of cute cartoon grapplers and freed champions sharing a giant plate of pasta, warm candlelight

frames.t: 'The Professor will know who the masked one is,' Mikey said. 'He knows everything. He's just... in a basement.'
frames.pt: 'O Professor vai saber quem é o mascarado', disse Mikey. 'Ele sabe de tudo. Ele só... vive num porão.'
frames.p: a stairwell leading down to a basement door with a blue light glowing underneath and diagrams of arrows taped on the door, mysterious

frames.t: The Professor took off his glasses and cleaned them slowly. 'Fascinating. You won with something I cannot diagram.'
frames.pt: O Professor tirou os óculos e limpou devagar. 'Fascinante. Vocês venceram com algo que eu não consigo desenhar no quadro.'
frames.p: a lean professorial coach in a navy rash guard and round glasses cleaning his glasses thoughtfully in a blue basement gym full of whiteboards

frames.t: He drew one last chart. Every arrow pointed to the same place: the World Grand Prix. 'He will be there. Waiting.'
frames.pt: Ele desenhou um último gráfico. Todas as setas apontavam para o mesmo lugar: o Grand Prix Mundial. 'Ele vai estar lá. Esperando.'
frames.p: a whiteboard covered in arrows and diagrams all pointing to a drawing of a big arena with a golden mask, marker in hand, dramatic lighting

frames.t: 'But first,' he sighed, 'you must free the Rubber Guard Rebel. He was... difficult before the spell.'
frames.pt: 'Mas antes', ele suspirou, 'vocês precisam libertar o Rebelde da Guarda de Borracha. Ele já era... complicado antes do feitiço.'
frames.p: a neon-lit grappling cage gym with psychedelic cosmic murals on the walls, a lone silhouette in a bendy pose inside the cage, purple haze

frames.t: Eddie Brave stretched his legs over his head. 'Duuude. Was that a spell, or did we all just level up in a simulation?'
frames.pt: Eddie Brave esticou as pernas por cima da cabeça. 'Caraaa. Aquilo foi um feitiço, ou a gente subiu de nível numa simulação?'
frames.p: a laid-back rebel grappler in a tie-dye rash guard stretching one leg over his head in a cage, grinning, the crew laughing, cosmic purple background

frames.t: Every freed champion showed up at the garage gym. 'We're coming with you,' said the Pressure King. 'In your corner.'
frames.pt: Todos os campeões libertados apareceram na academia de garagem. 'A gente vai com vocês', disse o Rei da Pressão. 'No seu córner.'
frames.p: a garage gym packed with a crowd of colorful friendly champions and the small crew, everyone raising fists together, warm light, string lights

frames.t: The crew tied their belts one more time. Ahead was the World Grand Prix, and the Masked Champion himself.
frames.pt: A equipe amarrou as faixas mais uma vez. À frente estava o Grand Prix Mundial, e o próprio Campeão Mascarado.
frames.p: a huge dark championship arena with a spotlight on a single mat, a tall hooded figure in a gold mask waiting in the center, a small crew entering from the tunnel

frames.t: The gold mask hit the mat. Underneath was just a tired grappler who had chased medals for so long that he forgot to have fun.
frames.pt: A máscara dourada caiu no tatame. Por baixo havia só um lutador cansado, que correu atrás de medalhas por tanto tempo que esqueceu de se divertir.
frames.p: a golden mask lying on a championship mat under a spotlight, a tired ordinary grappler sitting on the mat with his head in his hands, gentle sad light

frames.t: The scroll crumbled to dust. All over the world, the purple glow faded from every champion's eyes.
frames.pt: O pergaminho virou pó. No mundo todo, o brilho roxo sumiu dos olhos de cada campeão.
frames.p: a cursed violet scroll crumbling into golden dust and sparkles floating up into an arena sky, light breaking through

frames.t: The crew held out a hand. 'Open mat tomorrow. Garage gym. Bring a water bottle.' He took it. And everybody shouted: OSS!
frames.pt: A equipe estendeu a mão. 'Treino livre amanhã. Academia de garagem. Traz uma garrafinha.' Ele aceitou. E todo mundo gritou: OSS!
frames.p: a joyful garage gym open mat full of happy cartoon grapplers of every belt color and the freed champions training together, a former masked villain smiling, everyone raising fists, warm sunrise
